name: Curd
steps: This is a serving guide for ready-made plain curd, not a fermentation recipe. Keep the curd refrigerated until you are ready to portion it.
Use a clean spoon to transfer the required amount into a bowl. For a smooth texture, stir gently until even; for a set texture, spoon out portions without whisking.
Divide into clean individual bowls or a covered serving bowl. Keep refrigerated if not serving immediately, and use a separate clean spoon for serving.
tips: This is a serving guide for purchased curd.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Prices are sample ingredient-cost assumptions. Replace with supplier rates before procurement.
